tagline: Arsenal胶片单反相机，1972 年发布
description: Arsenal于1972年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Arsenal Vega-12 B 90mm f/2.8, semi-automatic。快门速度Horizontal focal plane metallic curtain, speeds: 1/30 - 1/1000, + B。使用120 roll, picture size 6x6cm。Fresnel ground glass screen。

specs.卡口: Salyut B mount (coarse-thread screw mount of Hasselblad 1600 type, with aperture release pin added)
specs.快门: Horizontal focal plane metallic curtain, speeds: 1/30 - 1/1000, + B
specs.取景器: Waist level finder with loupe, interchangeable
specs.闪光灯: w/ X and FP settings dial, synch. 1/30
specs.英文简介: Salyut-S (or Salut-S = Салют-C) is a medium format SLR film system camera, manufactured by Arsenal Factory, in Kiev, Ukraine, former USSR and produced between 1972-1980, quantity 30.000.
